description: This file contains functions and logic related to upgrading firmware images for different hardware platforms within the OpenWRT project, specifically targeting the MT7629 platform. It defines platform-specific upgrade procedures based on board identifiers.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A function intended to validate or check the firmware image, currently always returns success (0).

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs platform-specific firmware upgrade steps based on the detected board name.
